statusDefinitions.SUPPORTED: The listed evidence supports the claim within its stated scope.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: The listed evidence supports only part of the claim; limitations identify the unsupported portion.
statusDefinitions.UNMEASURED: No benchmark or representative measured dataset supports the claim.
statusDefinitions.NOT_CLAIMED: The capability is explicitly outside the current submission claim set.

evidenceClassDefinitions.mainnet_observation: A time-bound read from a mainnet network.
evidenceClassDefinitions.testnet_observation: A time-bound read or interaction on a test network.
evidenceClassDefinitions.historical_replay: A result produced by replaying a fixed historical dataset.
evidenceClassDefinitions.synthetic_fixture: A deterministic result produced from controlled fixture data.
evidenceClassDefinitions.publisher_claim: A statement or status returned by the operator's own service.

claims.claim: The public KNOT API and its database reported AVAILABLE.
limitations: This is a point-in-time self-reported health response, not an uptime guarantee.
The observation does not exercise authenticated task or job mutations.

claims.claim: The KNOT API implements repository-tested health, private task creation and read, and private job read boundaries.
limitations: Only the health endpoint was exercised in the published deployment observation.
Authenticated task and job operations are not exposed as a public demo.

claims.claim: The self-hosted HealthGuard public agent card returned HTTP 200, advertised negotiate and notify_funded operations plus OAuth client-credentials authentication, rejected unauthenticated invocation, and accepted an authenticated signed-quote request.
limitations: These availability and authentication observations cover one verification window and are not a long-term uptime measurement.
The authenticated smoke proves signed quote issuance; completed and recovered paid jobs are recorded separately.

claims.claim: KNOT HealthGuard is registered as ERC-8004 agent 2295 on BSC testnet for seller address 0xaF7474d06f171e6fD72fc5aF114b34f3D5AF8389, with analysis-only metadata pointing to the self-hosted agent card.
limitations: This is a testnet identity, not a mainnet registration.
Registration and metadata do not by themselves prove reliability or a completed commercial job.

claims.claim: An authenticated HealthGuard negotiation returned an accepted wallet-signed quote for 100000000000000000 base units of U on BSC testnet.
limitations: The exact observation time and full signed response were not archived as a public artifact.
This quote observation alone does not prove funding, delivery, verification, settlement, or earnings; funded jobs are recorded separately.

claims.claim: BSC testnet HealthGuard job 1180 was funded and submitted with a hash-matched deliverable, but the artifact was INVALID_REQUEST/INVALID_JSON after @bnbagent/sdk 0.5.5 changed JSON array brackets to parentheses; the buyer disputed it and recovered the full 0.1 U escrow through claimRefund after expiry.
limitations: The submitted artifact correctly refused malformed input but did not assess the requested health snapshot.
The job did not assess the requested health snapshot and is not counted as a successful service delivery.
The full escrow was refunded to the buyer; no seller earnings are claimed for this job.

claims.claim: BSC testnet HealthGuard job 1181 was funded and submitted; the retrieved deliverable matched its URL digest and on-chain manifest hash, passed the closed artifact schema, matched the signed task and snapshot identity, returned NO_DEBT for that pinned snapshot, and reached COMPLETED in a confirmed settlement that transferred 0.1 U from commerce escrow to the seller.
limitations: NO_DEBT is a result for one signed, pinned BSC mainnet snapshot and is not a guarantee about later borrower state.
This claim covers one HealthGuard job on BSC testnet, not mainnet payments or other marketplace services.
One completed testnet delivery is not a reliability or performance benchmark.

claims.claim: One HealthGuard job on BSC testnet completed the observed flow from a signed 0.1 U quote through funding, verified deliverable submission, and terminal settlement paying 0.1 U from commerce escrow to the seller.
limitations: This claim is limited to one HealthGuard job on BSC testnet.
It does not establish repeatability, coverage of the other services, mainnet payment readiness, or strategy performance.
Job 1180 remains separately recorded as a disputed invalid-input submission whose full escrow was recovered through the expiry refund path.

claims.claim: Permanent-endpoint BSC testnet HealthGuard job 1185 completed a signed 0.1 U paid flow against one pinned BSC mainnet Venus input; its content-addressed artifact passed integrity, closed-schema, task, and snapshot verification, terminal settlement transferred 0.1 U from escrow to the seller, and the paired independent evaluator found a four-dimension quality tie with the non-agent baseline on the exact same input.
limitations: Both paths received the same prepared pinned input; the baseline calculation timing does not include upstream input collection or human research.
The agent timing runs from quote start to confirmed submission, while the baseline timing covers calculation only, so the values do not establish a speed advantage.
HealthGuard and the reference baseline are operated by KNOT; the evaluator recomputes the expected outcome independently from raw evidence.
One no-debt input and one completed paid job do not establish repeatability, superiority, broader position coverage, or an uptime claim.
Payment used testnet U on BSC testnet; no real funds or mainnet writes were used.

claims.claim: One BSC testnet session was granted only U.balanceOf(address) call authority plus a 0.005 tBNB hourly native spend cap, successfully exercised that read, rejected totalSupply(), was revoked, and then rejected the formerly allowed read without changing the U balance or commerce allowance.
limitations: This claim covers one bounded BSC testnet session and no mainnet transaction or real funds.
The session could read one test-token function but could not transfer or approve tokens.
The native spend cap covered testnet relay fees and did not authorize ERC-20 spending.
Rejected calls failed during simulation and therefore have no transaction hashes.
One completed grant-and-revoke cycle is not a production-security or reliability guarantee.

claims.claim: Pinned Slither 0.11.3 output plus team manual validation on Shield's hash-frozen six-fixture corpus produced 2 true positives, 0 false positives, and 7 false negatives across 9 adjudicated findings; the ERC-1967 holdout produced 0 true positives, 0 false positives, and 3 false negatives.
limitations: All fixtures and adjudicated labels are team-owned, so this is not an independent external benchmark.
Manual validation is part of the measured pipeline and rejected two mapped analyzer signals before scoring, so the reported false-positive count is post-validation.
Ground-truth labels were not supplied to Slither; the evaluator consumed separately produced and hash-preserved artifacts.
The corpus contains only six synthetic fixtures, and its 2/9 recall and 0/3 holdout result do not establish comprehensive audit quality.
No production-security, deployment, or on-chain execution result is claimed.

claims.claim: A read-only preflight verified that BSC testnet agent 2293 was registered and exposed a live A2A card; it did not verify a compatible callable task, quote capability, hireability, or operator independence.
limitations: The selection intentionally covers known candidate 97:2293 first and is not an exhaustive audition of all 68 search matches.
A JSON-RPC validation error proves that a handler responded, not that a valid compatible task completed.
The quote endpoint returned COMMERCE_DISABLED, and no quote, purchase, funding, delivery, or comparison result is claimed.
Different registry-owner addresses do not establish that the controlling people or organizations are independent.
The candidate accepts caller-attested values while KNOT HealthGuard uses pinned Venus evidence, so their outputs are not directly equivalent without a normalized task.

claims.claim: One paired HealthGuard experiment has been published: the paid agent path and independent direct-calculation baseline used the exact same pinned no-debt input and tied across all four independently recomputed quality dimensions; no comparative result is published for the other three analysis categories.
limitations: The quality tie is one no-debt HealthGuard observation, not a superiority or repeatability result.
The differently scoped timing and cost observations do not establish a speed or cost advantage.
No comparative return, win-rate, execution, or live-trading result is claimed.
